figurative_meaning_en: Itching to quarrel or eagerness to start a fight
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জিহ্বা কণ্ডুয়ন করছে, সবসময় ছোটখাটো বিষয়ে ঝগড়া বাধাতে চায়।
এই লোকটার জিহ্বাকণ্ডুয়ন দেখে মনে হয় সে শান্তিতে থাকতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His tongue is itching; he always wants to pick a fight over small matters.
It seems like she has an itching tongue, as she can't stay out of arguments.
note: This idiom metaphorically links the physical sensation of itching to an uncontrollable urge for verbal confrontation in Bengali folklore expressions.
